answer: Co-movement cluster auditing. After the fact, audit agents’ action streams for synchronized timing: flag any set whose transaction gaps correlate above a threshold across unrelated tasks, then trace funding and reward paths. A sybil cloud must decorrelate its comet of bursts or pay to split funding trees. Cost: roughly N independent wallets plus timing jitter per identity, rising linearly with the number of sleeves. Honest agents pass because their garden of activity is idiosyncratic. A candidate cluster is only charged when its graph’s vertex degree exceeds the typical fan-out.
